author: Cosmian KMS security team <tech@cosmian.com>
tooling: Hand-curated; checked by `mise run sbom:validate`. Bump version and timestamp on every change.

statements.impact_statement: Scope: rsa 0.9.10 as compiled into the Cosmian KMS server and ckms (all variants). rsa is reached only through jsonwebtoken (JWT RS* signature verification) and, in non-FIPS builds, through pgp 0.21 for OpenPGP encryption, signature verification and key parsing; all of these are public-key operations. Every RSA private-key operation (PKESK decryption, signing, key generation) is performed by OpenSSL (crate/crypto/src/crypto/openpgp/mod.rs: component_session_key, OpensslRsaSigner), so the Marvin timing side channel in rsa private-key decryption is never executed.

statements.status_notes: Scope: crypto-bigint 0.5.5 as compiled into the Cosmian KMS server and ckms. No 0.5.x patch exists (fixed in >= 0.7.6, which the workspace uses for 0.7.x). FIPS builds reach it only via elliptic-curve 0.13 (p256/p384) from jsonwebtoken 10.4 for JWT ES256/ES384 signature verification over public inputs. Non-FIPS builds also reach it via pgp 0.21 -> cx448 0.1.1, used for OpenPGP X448/Ed448 secret-key operations (crate/crypto/src/crypto/openpgp/mod.rs: component_session_key falls back to pgp DecryptionKey::decrypt for non-RSA keys); exploitability of that path is not yet assessed.
